text:
leila: Heads-up: saw a subtle drift where inbound leads created with enrichment pending sometimes end up in HS with owner unset. Hit rate ~1.4% yesterday during the 11:00-12:00 UTC window. Can we triage?

omar: Yep, traces show enrichment backend had a short tail spike. Router treats long-pending as 'no-route' and we never set any handoff metadata, so workflows ignore them.

hs-bot: HubSpot event: 2026-03-22T11:07:22Z - new lead created (owner: null).

mike: Quick mitigation idea: lighthouse fallback. If enrichment pending > 20s, assign to a low-priority overflow (no sequences) and set hs_pending_enrich_ts + hs_handoff_note = 'lighthouse_fallback'. Schedule a reconcile job for 90s.

tara: I like lighthouse name. Also add hs_no_sequence boolean so nurture engines skip these. We need a clear audit label so BizOps can count SLA misses.

leila: Proposed router sketch:
```
if (lead.enrich_status == 'pending' && now - enrich_start > 20s && flag('marketing.lighthouse')) {
  assignOverflow('lighthouse_pool')
  setMeta('handoff_note','lighthouse_fallback')
  setMeta('pending_since', enrich_start)
  scheduleReconcile(90s)
}
```
This keeps handoff moving while letting enrichment finish if it does.

omar: Important: reconcile path must be idempotent and not trigger duplicate sequences. Add header X-Handoff-Origin: lighthouse_reconcile for SF/HS sync and a suppression field hs_no_sequence.

ops-bot: Deploy note: enrichment-worker v3.5.1 rolled 10:45 UTC (no rollback).

mike: HubSpot mapping proposal:
metadata.pending_since -> hs_pending_enrich_ts
metadata.handoff_note -> hs_handoff_note
metadata.reconcile_id -> hs_reconcile_id
hs_no_sequence -> hs_no_sequence

devon: I'll run a 48h audit to quantify impact and post numbers. SQL stub I'll use:
```
SELECT count(*) as n, hs_handoff_note
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '48 hours'
AND owner_id IS NULL
GROUP BY hs_handoff_note;
```
Posting results in ~30m.

tara: Also add metric fallback_rate and reconcile_success. Alert if fallback_rate > 0.5% sustained over 1h. Keep the feature flag off by default.

leila: Action items: omar implement lighthouse fallback behind marketing.lighthouse flag + PR, mike add HS mapping and suppression, devon run audit, tara wire metrics/alerts. We'll canary overnight if we have PR and mapping by tomorrow morning.

omar: I'll open PR tonight and include tests for the race where enrichment callback arrives just before/after fallback.

ops-bot: Incident tag created: #marketing-lighthouse-3187654321.

leila: Thanks team. Small canary should help avoid more ownerless leads while we investigate root cause with the enrichment vendor. :thumbsup:
